units.source_text: 我今身在京都，神往明石。

en.t: Though I am now in Kyoto, my heart longs for Akashi.
To go on living apart like this is more than one can bear.

units.source_text: 务望早作决心，来此相聚。

en.t: I earnestly hope you will soon make up your mind and come here so that we may be together.

units.source_text: 此间万事妥善，一切无须顾虑。”

en.t: Everything here is properly arranged, and you need have no worries at all."

units.source_text: 明石道人照例喜极而泣。

en.t: As usual, the Akashi monk wept with overwhelming joy.

units.source_text: 际此时机，感激太甚，难怪他要哭的。

en.t: At such a moment, his gratitude was so deep that it was no wonder he cried.

units.source_text: 他家里也正在庆祝五十朝，排场十分体面。

en.t: His household was also just then celebrating the fiftieth day, and the arrangements were very dignified.

units.source_text: 倘没有京中使者看到，便似衣锦夜行，太可惜了。

en.t: If the messengers from the capital had not seen it, it would have been like wearing brocade in the dark, a great pity.
